_readme: Nano Banana Pro = Gemini 3 Pro Image (House job pictures.object, an alternate, not routed). Filled 2026-10-26 from Google's Gemini API image-generation page and Google's Nano Banana Pro prompting tips; the API page was long and its Pro section could not be read in full, so the reference-image breakdown is flagged to verify. Every entry is draft.
No brand, product, person or format word appears in this file.
label: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image)

limits.max_images_note: Google's tips: blend up to 6 to 14 unconnected images depending on the surface; the API page lists up to 6 object images, 5 character images and 3 style images in its comparison table (flattened in the fetch: verify)
limits.image_sizes: 1K (default), 2K, 4K; the K must be uppercase, lowercase is rejected
limits.aspect_ratios: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9 (the list Higgsfield shows for this model; Google's page list for Pro was not readable)
limits.thinking: on by default and cannot be switched off in the API; up to two interim images, the last is the final
limits.watermark: every generated image carries a SynthID watermark
limits.multi_turn: multi-turn conversation is the recommended way to iterate

house.use: alternate object-picture model, not routed; the third rung of the picture ladder

google.note: Google's own API: aspectRatio and imageSize in generationConfig.imageConfig

higgsfield.references: role image_references; at most 14 (Higgsfield's own rule); a non-empty prompt or at least one reference is required
higgsfield.differs: Reachable through the Higgsfield command line only: the keyed API answers model_disabled.

inputs.name: contents (text + images)
inputs.what: The prompt and the reference pictures, in one request.
inputs.allowed: images up to 14 in total depending on the surface; give each a role in the text
inputs.we_send: the same references as the other picture models

inputs.name: aspectRatio
inputs.allowed: 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9; the output matches the first reference's ratio if none is set

structure.rule: Core elements: subject, composition, action, location, style, and the editing instruction; add aspect ratio, camera and lighting, text placement, factual constraints and reference roles for professional results.
Describe the scene in full sentences, not keywords.
Define the role of each uploaded image: 'Use Image A for the pose, Image B for the art style, Image C for the background.' State how the references relate.
For an edit be direct and specific about the change and state what stays the same.
Define the canvas with an aspect ratio in the prompt too ('a 9:16 vertical poster').
Direct it like a cinematographer: angle, depth of field, lighting, colour grading.
State exactly what text appears and how: the words in quotes, the font style, the placement.
For diagrams or factual pictures request accuracy explicitly and supply factual inputs.
Iterate by conversation: one change at a time, restating what must hold.

avoid.text: Expecting perfect small text, fine detail or spelling.
Trusting data-driven or factual visuals without checking them.
Assuming text in other languages is free of grammar errors.
Expecting complex edits, blends or lighting changes to be free of artifacts.
Assuming character consistency stays perfect across edits.
Lowercase image sizes: '2k' is rejected, send '2K'.
Studio, cinematic or staged wording when you want a real photo.
A person's name, a date or a quote from our own rulings inside the prompt: the model draws it as picture content.

history.was: alternate object-picture model, not routed (one door, GPT Image, the owner 2026-09-22)
